summary: Five implementable SMC/ICT subagent specs for 5-min NSE cash candles: (1) structure — 3-bar fractal swings with a trend state machine emitting BOS/CHoCH/MSS events scored with recency decay; (2) zones — order blocks (last opposite candle before an ATR-scaled displacement), 3-candle FVGs, breaker conversion on invalidation, scored by exponential distance-to-nearest-zone; (3) liquidity — ATR-tolerance equal-high/low clusters plus PDH/PDL, wick-beyond-then-reclaim sweep detection, discount/premium position within a 100-bar dealing range; (4) timing — NSE-session killzone table (open drive 09:25-10:30, mid-day chop 11:30-13:00, closing hour 14:15-15:10) with opening-range and gap modifiers; (5) advanced — session-adapted Power-of-3/AMD (09:15-10:15 accumulation range, Judas-swing sweep-and-reclaim, distribution alignment) blended 55/45 with a displacement-leg + FVG-cluster component. All scores are 0-100 per direction, computable in one pass over <=200 cached closed candles (well under 1s), using only Shoonya TPSeries data plus timestamps; no option-chain, depth, or external data needed by this family.

algorithms.name: SMC Market Structure (BOS / CHoCH / MSS)
algorithms.inputs: Last 200 closed 5m candles for the signal symbol from cached TPSeries: time, into (open), inth (high), intl (low), intc (close). Signal direction (BUY/SELL). Derived: ATR14 (Wilder) on the same series. Drop the currently forming candle.
algorithms.steps: 1) Compute ATR14 (Wilder smoothing) over the candle array. 2) Swing pivots, fractal N=3: bar i is a PIVOT HIGH if high[i] >= high[i-1..i-3] AND high[i] > high[i+1..i+3] (>= on the left, strict > on the right resolves equal-high ties deterministically). PIVOT LOW mirrored (<= left, < right). A pivot is CONFIRMED only at bar i+3; unconfirmed pivots are never used. Keep the 20 most recent confirmed pivots of each type. 3) Trend state machine, processed bar-by-bar over the window. State: trend in {UP, DOWN, NONE} (init NONE); last unbroken pivot high price PH_u; last unbroken pivot low price PL_u; 'protected' swing = in UP trend the pivot low that immediately precedes the most recent pivot high, in DOWN trend the pivot high immediately preceding the most recent pivot low. 4) Break test on each closed bar t (close-based, per the full-bodied-candle convention): BULL_BREAK if close[t] > PH_u + 0.05*ATR14; BEAR_BREAK if close[t] < PL_u - 0.05*ATR14. Each pivot can be broken once (mark consumed). 5) Event labelling: trend==UP and BULL_BREAK -> BOS_UP. trend==UP and BEAR_BREAK of the protected pivot low -> CHoCH_DOWN, set trend=DOWN. trend==DOWN and BEAR_BREAK -> BOS_DOWN. trend==DOWN and BULL_BREAK of the protected pivot high -> CHoCH_UP, set trend=UP. trend==NONE: first break sets trend and is labelled BOS. 6) MSS upgrade (ICT variant: CHoCH + liquidity sweep + displacement): a CHoCH_UP is upgraded to MSS_UP if BOTH (a) sweep: leg_low < previous pivot low's price, where leg_low = min(low) between the bar of the broken pivot high and the break bar (the reversal leg first ran sell-side liquidity), AND (b) displacement: break candle body |close-open| >= 0.6*ATR14. MSS_DOWN mirrored (leg_high > previous pivot high, body >= 0.6*ATR14). 7) Record events as (type, bar_index). Output for scoring: current trend, most recent event within 40 bars, last two pivot highs and last two pivot lows, most recent confirmed pivot low/high prices. 8) If fewer than 60 closed bars available, return 50/50 neutral.
algorithms.buy_score_logic: score_buy = clamp(50 + trend_term + event_term + geometry_term, 0, 100). trend_term: +15 if trend==UP, -15 if DOWN, 0 if NONE. event_term: from the most recent event within 40 bars (0 if none), value * exp(-bars_since_event / 15): MSS_UP +35, CHoCH_UP +28, BOS_UP +18, BOS_DOWN -18, CHoCH_DOWN -28, MSS_DOWN -35. geometry_term: (last two pivot lows rising AND last two pivot highs rising) +8; (both falling) -8; mixed 0. Plus: signal close within 0.5*ATR14 above most recent confirmed pivot low (buying at structural support) +7; within 0.5*ATR14 below most recent confirmed pivot high (buying into resistance) -7.
algorithms.sell_score_logic: Exact mirror: score_sell = clamp(50 + trend_term + event_term + geometry_term). trend_term: +15 if DOWN, -15 if UP. event_term with same decay: MSS_DOWN +35, CHoCH_DOWN +28, BOS_DOWN +18, BOS_UP -18, CHoCH_UP -28, MSS_UP -35. geometry_term: both pivot series falling +8, both rising -8; close within 0.5*ATR below last pivot high (selling at resistance) +7; within 0.5*ATR above last pivot low (selling into support) -7.
algorithms.default_weight: 1.0 buy / 1.0 sell - market structure is the backbone of the SMC family; every other agent's reading is conditioned on it, so it gets full weight.
algorithms.data_requirements: Shoonya TPSeries (interval=5) for the cash series symbol, >=200 bars cached and rolled forward each bar close; fields time, into, inth, intl, intc only (volume/OI unused). No REST call at signal time - read from cache. If cache has <60 closed bars (new listing, data gap), return neutral 50 for both directions and set a 'degraded' flag.
algorithms.params: fractal_wing N=3; pivot_history=20; break_buffer=0.05*ATR14; event_lookback=40 bars; event_halflife=15 bars; mss_body_min=0.6*ATR14; atr_period=14; min_bars=60.

algorithms.name: SMC Zones (Order Blocks, FVG, Breaker/Mitigation)
algorithms.inputs: Same cached 200 closed 5m candles (OHLC), ATR14, last close P (signal price), signal direction. Nothing else.
algorithms.steps: 1) Displacement definition (used throughout): a candle with body |close-open| >= 1.2*ATR14, OR two consecutive same-direction candles with combined bodies >= 1.8*ATR14. 2) BULLISH ORDER BLOCK: candle i is bearish (close<open); the move starting at i+1 is a bullish displacement (criterion over i+1 alone or i+1..i+2); and the displacement leg's final close > high[i]. Zone = [low[i], high[i]] (full candle range variant). If several consecutive bearish candles precede the displacement, only the LAST one (i) is the OB. Set flag ob_has_fvg=True if an FVG (step 3) forms anywhere in candles i..i+3 (an OB backed by an imbalance is higher quality, per standard ICT guidance). BEARISH OB mirrored: last bullish candle before bearish displacement whose leg closes < low[i]; zone [low[i], high[i]]. 3) FVG (3-candle imbalance), candles a,b,c consecutive (c newest): BULLISH if low[c] > high[a]; zone = [high[a], low[c]]. BEARISH if high[c] < low[a]; zone = [high[c], low[a]]. Filters: gap height >= 0.15*ATR14 AND middle-candle body >= 0.8*ATR14 (kills noise gaps). 4) Zone lifecycle, evaluated on every closed bar after formation. States: FRESH -> MITIGATED -> DEAD; or -> INVALIDATED. Mitigation (bullish zone): a later bar's low <= zone_top without invalidation; count separate mitigations (separated by >=3 bars fully outside the zone); after 2 mitigations the zone is DEAD. Invalidation (bullish OB or FVG): any later 5m CLOSE < zone_bottom - 0.05*ATR14 (bearish mirrored: close > zone_top + 0.05*ATR14). 5) BREAKER: an invalidated bullish OB converts to a BEARISH BREAKER with the same [low,high] zone, live for the next 50 bars; invalidated bearish OB -> bullish breaker. A breaker dies if price closes back through it in the original direction (bearish breaker: close > zone_top + 0.05*ATR). Invalidated FVGs simply die (no conversion). 6) MITIGATION BLOCK (simplified): if a bar's WICK pierces the invalidation level but the bar closes back inside/beyond the zone, the OB keeps its polarity but is flagged weakened (score multiplier 0.7). 7) Bookkeeping: keep at most 8 active zones per polarity, newest first; drop zones older than 200 bars. 8) Scoring uses nearest active bullish zone at/below P (support) and nearest active bearish zone at/above P (overhead); 'inside' counts as distance 0.
algorithms.buy_score_logic: Let ATR=ATR14, P=last close. Support: nearest active bullish zone with zone_top <= P or containing P; d = max(0, P - zone_top). base by type: OB with ob_has_fvg 40, plain OB 35, bullish breaker 32, bullish FVG 30. freshness f: FRESH 1.0, mitigated-once 0.65; multiply by 0.7 if weakened flag. support_term = base * f * exp(-d / (0.6*ATR)); 0 if no such zone. Overhead: nearest active bearish zone with zone_bottom >= P; d2 = max(0, zone_bottom - P); overhead_term = 25 * f * exp(-d2 / (0.9*ATR)); 0 if none. Extra: if P is INSIDE an active bearish zone, additional -10. score_buy = clamp(45 + support_term - overhead_term + extra). Base is 45 (not 50) so a signal with zero zone confluence reads slightly below neutral.
algorithms.sell_score_logic: Exact mirror: support side = nearest active BEARISH zone with zone_bottom >= P (d = zone_bottom - P), same base values (bearish OB+FVG 40, OB 35, bearish breaker 32, bearish FVG 30), same freshness multipliers, support_term = base*f*exp(-d/(0.6*ATR)). Overhead penalty from nearest active BULLISH zone with zone_top <= P: 25*f*exp(-d2/(0.9*ATR)), d2 = P - zone_top. Extra -10 if P inside an active bullish zone. score_sell = clamp(45 + support_term - overhead_term + extra).
algorithms.default_weight: 0.9 buy / 0.9 sell - zone confluence is the entry-location edge of SMC and directly validates a mean-reversion entry, but it is one notch below structure because a zone against structure is a trap.
algorithms.data_requirements: Cached TPSeries 5m OHLC only (same array as smc_structure - share the cache and the ATR computation). All zones are maintained incrementally per symbol as each bar closes, so signal-time work is just two nearest-zone lookups. If <60 bars, return 50/50 with degraded flag.
algorithms.params: atr_period=14; disp_body_mult=1.2; disp_two_bar_mult=1.8; fvg_min_gap=0.15*ATR; fvg_mid_body_min=0.8*ATR; invalidation_buffer=0.05*ATR; mitigations_to_death=2; mitigation_separation=3 bars; breaker_ttl=50 bars; max_zones_per_side=8; zone_max_age=200 bars; support_decay=0.6*ATR; overhead_decay=0.9*ATR; base_score=45.

algorithms.name: SMC Liquidity (pools, sweeps, internal/external range)
algorithms.inputs: Cached 200 closed 5m candles (OHLC), ATR14, last close P, previous day's high/low/close (aggregate yesterday's 5m bars from the same cache), signal direction.
algorithms.steps: 1) Minor swings, fractal N=2 (lighter than structure agent): swing high at i if high[i] >= high[i-1..i-2] and > high[i+1..i+2]; confirmed at i+2; lows mirrored. 2) EQUAL-HIGHS POOL: among confirmed minor swing highs in the last 75 bars, greedy-cluster: walk swings newest to oldest, group any whose price is within tol = max(0.15*ATR14, 0.0005*P) of the group's max. A cluster with >=2 members is a pool; pool_level = max price in cluster; pool_size = member count. EQUAL-LOWS mirrored with min. Previous-day high (PDH) and low (PDL) are automatically pools of size 2. The 100-bar dealing-range extremes (step 5) are EXTERNAL pools; all others INTERNAL. 3) UNTAPPED test: a highs-pool is untapped while no later bar's high > pool_level + tol since the cluster's newest swing; lows mirrored. 4) SWEEP detection (sell-side sweep of a lows-pool, the BUY-supporting event): bar s with low[s] < pool_level - 0.05*ATR14 AND (close[s] > pool_level OR some bar within the next 2 bars closes > pool_level). The sweep event bar = the reclaiming close bar. If instead price closes below pool_level for 3+ consecutive bars, it is a BREAKDOWN, not a sweep (pool consumed, no bullish event). Strong-sweep flag if the reclaim candle body >= 0.6*ATR14 (displacement reclaim, per ICT a genuine sweep is followed by displacement). Buy-side sweeps of highs-pools mirrored. Each pool can be swept once, then is consumed. 5) DEALING RANGE (external range): range_high = max(high), range_low = min(low) over last 100 bars; range_pos = (P - range_low) / max(range_high - range_low, 1e-9). range_pos < 0.5 = discount (favors BUY), > 0.5 = premium (favors SELL). A sweep whose pool is a dealing-range extreme or PDH/PDL gets external multiplier 1.25.
algorithms.buy_score_logic: score_buy = clamp(40 + sweep_term + target_term + risk_term + range_term). sweep_term: most recent SELL-SIDE sweep within 15 bars -> 38 * Q * exp(-bars_since/8), where Q = 1.0, *1.2 if strong-sweep flag, *1.25 if external/PDL, *(1 + 0.1*(pool_size-2)), Q capped at 1.5. If instead the most recent sweep within 15 bars was a BUY-SIDE sweep (upside liquidity already taken - bearish), sweep_term = -20 * exp(-bars_since/8). No sweep: 0. target_term: nearest UNTAPPED equal-highs pool above P (draw on liquidity target): +10 if 0.7*ATR <= distance <= 3*ATR; +4 if distance < 0.7*ATR (magnet too close, rejection risk); 0 if none within 3*ATR. risk_term: -12 if an untapped equal-lows pool sits below P within 1*ATR (price is likely to be drawn down to purge it first). range_term: clamp((0.5 - range_pos) * 30, -15, +15).
algorithms.sell_score_logic: Exact mirror: score_sell = clamp(40 + sweep_term + target_term + risk_term + range_term). sweep_term: recent BUY-SIDE sweep (above equal highs / PDH / range high) within 15 bars -> 38 * Q * exp(-bars_since/8), same Q rules; recent sell-side sweep -> -20 * decay. target_term: nearest untapped equal-LOWS pool below P: +10 in [0.7,3]*ATR, +4 if <0.7*ATR. risk_term: -12 if untapped equal-highs pool above P within 1*ATR. range_term: clamp((range_pos - 0.5) * 30, -15, +15).
algorithms.default_weight: 1.0 buy / 1.0 sell - sweep-then-reclaim is mechanically the same event the RSI+W%R mean-reversion trigger fires on, so this agent is the strongest confluence/veto in the family.
algorithms.data_requirements: Cached TPSeries 5m OHLC (shared array); previous-day H/L/C computed by grouping cached bars by session date - if yesterday's bars are absent from cache, fetch one extra day of TPSeries at startup, never at signal time. If <60 bars, neutral 50/50.
algorithms.params: minor_fractal_N=2; pool_lookback=75 bars; cluster_tol=max(0.15*ATR14, 5 bps of price); sweep_pierce_buffer=0.05*ATR; reclaim_window=2 bars; breakdown_bars=3; strong_sweep_body=0.6*ATR; sweep_lookback=15 bars; sweep_halflife=8 bars; dealing_range=100 bars; external_mult=1.25; base_score=40.

algorithms.name: NSE Session Killzones (timing)
algorithms.inputs: Signal bar start timestamp (IST), today's 5m bars so far (for opening range), today's open, previous day close, optional config flag is_expiry_day (monthly F&O expiry: last Thursday, or prior trading day if holiday).
algorithms.steps: 1) All times IST; a bar belongs to the window containing its START time; signal time = start time of the triggering bar. 2) Base window table (adapted killzones for the 09:15-15:30 NSE cash session): [09:15-09:25) -> 40 (first two bars: erratic price discovery, wide spreads); [09:25-10:30) -> 80 (open-drive killzone: peak institutional participation, day's trend often set); [10:30-11:30) -> 62 (post-open continuation); [11:30-13:00) -> 35 (mid-day chop / lunch doldrums, lowest volume); [13:00-14:15) -> 60 (re-engagement; European desks active after London open ~13:30 IST); [14:15-15:10) -> 75 (closing-hour killzone: MTM and intraday square-off flows produce clean directional moves); [15:10-15:30] -> 25 (broker auto-square-off ~15:20; no time for a trade to work). 3) Opening range (OR) = high/low of 09:15-09:45 (first 6 bars); only defined from 09:45 onward. 4) Gap% = (today_open - prev_day_close) / prev_day_close; gap modifier applies only to signals before 10:30. 5) Expiry-day modifier applies only from 11:30 onward. 6) Final score per direction = clamp(base + modifiers). This agent never vetoes on its own; it shades probability by session phase.
algorithms.buy_score_logic: score_buy = clamp(base(window) + or_mod + gap_mod + expiry_mod). or_mod (from 09:45): P > OR_high -> +8; P < OR_low -> -8; inside OR -> 0. gap_mod (before 10:30 only, |gap%| >= 0.3%): gap up -> +6, gap down -> -6 (gap-and-go dominates NSE first hour). expiry_mod: -10 if is_expiry_day and time >= 11:30 (gamma pinning, erratic tape). Example: BUY at 09:50 with price above OR high on a +0.5% gap day = 80+8+6 = 94.
algorithms.sell_score_logic: score_sell = clamp(base(window) + or_mod + gap_mod + expiry_mod) with mirrored signs: P < OR_low -> +8, P > OR_high -> -8; gap down -> +6, gap up -> -6; same expiry -10. Base table identical for both directions.
algorithms.default_weight: 0.6 buy / 0.6 sell - timing carries no directional information of its own (mostly symmetric); it should gate/shade the composite, not drive it, hence the reduced weight.
algorithms.data_requirements: Needs only timestamps from the shared 5m cache plus previous day close (from the cached prior session's last bar). is_expiry_day must be supplied by the orchestrator from an NSE holiday/expiry calendar config file (the Shoonya API does not provide it) - if absent, expiry_mod = 0. If prev day close unavailable, skip gap_mod. Never returns degraded; always computable.
algorithms.params: window boundaries and base scores as in step 2 (all configurable as a list of (start,end,score) tuples); or_bars=6 (09:15-09:45); or_mod=8; gap_threshold=0.30%; gap_mod=6; gap_window_end=10:30; expiry_mod=-10 after 11:30; auto_squareoff_cutoff=15:10.

algorithms.name: Advanced: Power of 3 (AMD) + Displacement-FVG Cluster
algorithms.inputs: Today's session 5m closed bars (from shared cache, session start 09:15 identified by timestamp), full 200-bar cache for the displacement scan, ATR14, last close P, signal direction, signal timestamp.
algorithms.steps: COMPONENT A - session-adapted Power of 3 (Accumulation-Manipulation-Distribution): 1) Accumulation window = 09:15-10:15 (first 12 bars). AR_high = max high, AR_low = min low, AR_mid = midpoint. If (AR_high - AR_low) < 0.8*ATR14, widen the window to 09:15-10:45 (18 bars) and recompute. Component A is only evaluated after the accumulation window has fully closed; before that it returns neutral 50. 2) Manipulation (Judas swing) DOWN: after window close, first bar m with low[m] < AR_low - 0.1*ATR14 followed by a close back above AR_low within 4 bars (counting m). Manipulation UP mirrored above AR_high. Detect at most one per side; if both sides were swept, the MOST RECENT one is operative. A push below AR_low that never reclaims within 4 bars is a breakout, not manipulation. 3) Distribution read: after operative manipulation DOWN the day model is bullish (open -> manipulate lower making the day's low -> distribute higher); grade by where P sits versus AR_mid/AR_low now, with a displacement-reclaim bonus (reclaim candle body >= 0.6*ATR14). COMPONENT B - displacement leg + FVG cluster: 4) Scan the last 30 closed bars for displacement legs: maximal runs of 1-5 consecutive bars with net move |close_last - open_first| >= 1.8*ATR14 and >=70% of the run's bars closing in the net direction. 5) For each leg, count FVGs inside it in the leg's direction using EXACTLY the zones-agent FVG definition and filters (reuse that code); record whether each FVG is still unfilled (no later close through it). 6) Operative leg = most recent leg containing >=1 FVG. 7) Blend: final = clamp(0.55 * A + 0.45 * B) per direction.
algorithms.buy_score_logic: A_buy: 50 if accumulation window not yet closed or no manipulation detected. If operative manipulation = DOWN (bullish Judas): 85 if P > AR_mid; 70 if AR_low <= P <= AR_mid; 60 if P < AR_low but the reclaim was within the last 3 bars (fresh reversal); else 55. Add +8 if the reclaim candle was a displacement (body >= 0.6*ATR); cap 95. If operative manipulation = UP (bearish day model): 30 if P < AR_mid, else 40. B_buy: operative leg UP -> 60 + 8*min(n_fvg,3) + 12 if P is inside (or within 0.2*ATR of) one of that leg's UNFILLED bullish FVGs (pullback-into-imbalance), cap 96. Operative leg DOWN -> 32 - 4*min(n_fvg,3), floor 20. No qualifying leg in 30 bars -> 50. score_buy = clamp(0.55*A_buy + 0.45*B_buy).
algorithms.sell_score_logic: Exact mirror. A_sell: operative manipulation UP (sweep above AR_high then reclaim below - bearish Judas): 85 if P < AR_mid; 70 if AR_mid <= P <= AR_high; 60 if P > AR_high with reclaim in last 3 bars; else 55; +8 displacement-reclaim bonus, cap 95. Operative manipulation DOWN: 30 if P > AR_mid else 40. No manipulation / window open: 50. B_sell: operative leg DOWN -> 60 + 8*min(n_fvg,3) + 12 if P inside/within 0.2*ATR of an unfilled bearish FVG of that leg, cap 96; operative leg UP -> 32 - 4*min(n_fvg,3), floor 20; none -> 50. score_sell = clamp(0.55*A_sell + 0.45*B_sell).
algorithms.default_weight: 0.7 buy / 0.7 sell - a composite, more heuristic model (AMD is only meaningful after ~10:15 and B overlaps partially with the zones agent), so weight it below the core structure/liquidity agents.
algorithms.data_requirements: Shared 5m cache only; session bars selected by timestamp date + start 09:15 IST. Reuse the zones agent's FVG detector and ATR - do not reimplement. Before 10:15 (or 10:45 in fallback) component A is neutral, so early signals are scored ~ by component B alone; this is intended, not degraded. If <60 total bars, return 50/50.
algorithms.params: accum_bars=12 (fallback 18 if range < 0.8*ATR14); sweep_buffer=0.1*ATR; reclaim_window=4 bars; fresh_reversal_window=3 bars; displacement_reclaim_body=0.6*ATR; leg_net_move=1.8*ATR; leg_max_bars=5; leg_direction_purity=70%; leg_scan=30 bars; fvg_count_cap=3; fvg_proximity=0.2*ATR; blend A/B = 0.55/0.45.

notes: Implementation conventions shared by all five agents: (1) clamp(x) = min(100, max(0, x)); all scores 0-100 per direction, 50 = neutral/no-information. (2) Use ONLY closed 5m candles - drop the forming bar. (3) ATR14 = Wilder-smoothed true range on the shared 5m array; compute once per symbol per bar close and share across agents, along with the candle cache and the FVG detector (zones and advanced must use the same code). (4) All state (pivots, zones, pools, AMD flags) is updated incrementally on each bar close, so signal-time evaluation is a handful of lookups - comfortably <1s even for a fresh full 200-bar recompute. (5) ATR-relative thresholds everywhere make the specs work unchanged across Rs.100 and Rs.5000 NSE stocks; the only absolute floor is the 5 bps cluster tolerance in the liquidity agent. (6) The family needs nothing beyond TPSeries 5m OHLC + timestamps + an orchestrator-supplied expiry/holiday calendar; no option chain, depth, VIX, or websocket fields - so these agents are fully backtestable from candle history alone. Variant choices made where ICT sources diverge: close-based (not wick-based) structure breaks with a 0.05*ATR buffer; OB zone = full candle range (not open-to-extreme); MSS = CHoCH + prior liquidity sweep + displacement body (per ICT's stricter definition vs generic SMC CHoCH); breaker = polarity-flipped invalidated OB, while the wick-pierced-but-held case is treated as a weakened mitigation block (0.7 multiplier) rather than a separate zone type; AMD mapped to NSE as opening-range accumulation / OR-sweep Judas / rest-of-day distribution instead of Asia-London-NY sessions. Sources consulted: innercircletrader.net tutorials (MSS vs CHoCH: https://innercircletrader.net/tutorials/mss-vs-choch/ ; BOS: https://innercircletrader.net/tutorials/break-of-structure-bos/ ; order block: https://innercircletrader.net/tutorials/ict-order-block/ ; mitigation vs breaker: https://innercircletrader.net/tutorials/ict-mitigation-block-explained/ ; liquidity sweep vs run: https://innercircletrader.net/tutorials/ict-liquidity-sweep-vs-liquidity-run/ ; liquidity pools: https://innercircletrader.net/tutorials/ict-liquidity-pool/ ; Power of 3: https://innercircletrader.net/tutorials/ict-power-of-3/), Backtrex MSS guide (https://backtrex.com/en/blog/ict-market-structure-shift-mss-guide), LuxAlgo MSS (https://www.luxalgo.com/blog/market-structure-shifts-mss-in-ict-trading/), Zeiierman liquidity sweeps (https://www.zeiierman.com/blog/liquidity-sweeps-in-trading), ThinkCapital AMD guide (https://www.thinkcapital.com/accumulation-distribution-guide/). Suggested composite: within the SMC family, weighted mean with the listed weights (structure 1.0, liquidity 1.0, zones 0.9, advanced 0.7, timing 0.6); consider a hard floor rule at the orchestrator level - if smc_structure scores <30 for the signal direction, cap the family output at 40 regardless of the other agents, since zones/liquidity confluence against structure is the classic SMC trap.
